page.overview:
Who is Bennie Caliper?

Bennie Caliper is a minor character in Cars. He is a Remirunabout MenV that loves movies.

"Bennie Caliper loves movies. He goes to the theater every chance he gets, and he loves the way a good story can take you away from the day to day troubles of your life. He is currently working on his first original screenplay about a cop that's forced to partner up with an inner city garbage truck, and it's called, "Trash Talkin' Cop.""

He is seen watching movies with Mack while he comments on the roles of John Ratzenberger in Toy Car Story as Hamm, Monsters Trucks, Inc. as the Yeti, and A Bug's Life as P.T. Flea.
